title: Southern Japan Highlights | Group Tour Package
highlights: Discover Japan's fusion of ancient traditions and futuristic innovation, present together its vibrant cities, serene landscapes, and cultural heritage.
Visit Hiroshima Peace Memorial, a symbol honoring the tragic events of World War II, offering an honest reflection on peace and resilience.
Ascend Matsuyama Castle and dive into its storied past as one of Japan's twelve original castles, offering stunning views.
Cross the Naruto Bridge, renowned for its dramatic whirlpools in the Naruto Strait, and experience the thrill of nature's power.
Explore Kibitsu Shrine in Okayama, dating back over 1,300 years, and experience the serenity of its sacred grounds.
inclusions: Transfer from Osaka International Airport to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: All visitors need to carry a valid ID Proof.
Remove shoes before entering homes or certain traditional temples.
Learning basic Japanese phrases or using a translation app can be helpful.
While credit cards are becoming more accepted, many places still prefer cash. ATMs that accept foreign cards are available at convenience stores and post offices.
Tipping is not customary in Japan and may be considered rude. Instead, show appreciation through polite behavior and gratitude.
Follow local customs, such as not pointing feet, maintaining quiet in public places, and respecting religious sites.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Leisure Time
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at the Osaka airport, get driven to your hotel. Check in and spend your time at leisure. You can explore Osaka Castle and its iconic main tower, offering panoramic views of Osaka and showcasing exhibits on samurai culture. Next, you can visit Namba Yasaka Shrine, renowned for its striking lion-shaped stage, which symbolizes protection and good fortune. Afterward, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Osaka City Centre - Midosuji, an IHG Hotel

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | En-route Visit Himeji Castle | Okayama Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Okayama. En route, stop at Himeji to visit the UNESCO-listed Himeji Castle, renowned for its majestic white facade. Continue your journey to Okayama, where you will stroll around Korakuen, featuring manicured lawns, historic bridges, and a scenic tea house. Next, visit Kibitsu-Jinja, a Shinto shrine famous for its distinctive 360-meter corridor. Enjoy some leisure time exploring Okayama before heading to your hotel. Check in and rest for the night.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Leisure Time in Kurashiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour | Trip to Miyajima Island
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to Hiroshima with a stop in Kurashiki. Here, visit the Ohara Museum and Achi Shrine. Continue to Hiroshima & prepare yourself for a walking tour. Visit the iconic Peace Memorial, the Atomic Bomb Dome, and the Peace Memorial Museum. Next, get driven to Miyajimaguchi harbor to catch a ferry to Miyajima Island. Upon arrival, explore Itsukushima Shrine with its famous floating torii gate, and visit the Daishoin Temple. Finally, return to Hiroshima & check in at your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Matsuyama by boat | Cable Car Ride to Matsuyama Castle | Visit to Ishiteji Temple & Dogo Onsen
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Hiroshima Port to board a boat to Matsuyama. Upon arrival at Matsuyama Port, get driven to Chojaganaru Station for a scenic cable car ride up to Matsuyama Castle. Explore the historic fortress and enjoy sweeping views from the top. Next, visit the architectural marvel of Ishiteji Temple, and then experience the traditional ambiance of Dogo Onsen, a historic bathhouse. Conclude your day with a transfer to your hotel. Check in and rest for the night.

days.title: Transfer to Kobe | En Route visit to Kotohira Shrine, Ritsurin & Naruto Bridge
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and get driven to Kobe. En route, visit Kotohira Shrine, a Shinto shrine admired by sailors and seafarers. Continue to Takamatsu, where you'll explore the renowned Ritsurin Garden and enjoy the stunning views of Mount Shiun. Next, stop at the iconic Naruto Bridge and walk along the Uzu no Michi, a glass-floored walkway beneath the bridge. Finally, get transferred to your hotel in Kobe. Check in and rest for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Earthquake Memorial Museum | Departure from Osaka
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to visit the Earthquake Memorial Museum, honoring the devastating Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake that struck on January 17, 1995. Later, board your transfer to Osaka and continue your journey forward, to mark the end of this trip.
